findings.reason: Node likely marks the MDI Limbach Berlin lab, ~300 staff company-wide. Its own site shows the Sonnenburger Str. 70 lab (near this point) as "ehemaliges Labor"; operations are at Aroser Allee 84 (Reinickendorf). The tag is probably outdated, so few or no workers are here now.

sources.quote: Ehemaliges Labor am Standort Sonnenburger Str. 70

findings.evidence_needed: Confirm the node's street address (Sonnenburger Str. 70?) and whether any lab or sample-collection point is still operating there.

findings.reason: The 5-level school building (8,300 m²) is probably the Thomas-Mann-Grundschule, Greifenhagener Str. 58, a public school and not in the registry. About 490 pupils plus staff and after-school workers use it daily, against about 25 registered workers.

sources.quote: Heute besuchen rund 490 Schüler:innen im Alter von sechs bis dreizehn Jahren unsere Schule.

findings.evidence_needed: Confirm the building is Greifenhagener Str. 58; get the staff count (teachers, educators) from the Schulportrait.

findings.reason: Colosseum cinema complex. The 21,552 m² floor area comes from 4 tagged levels over a 5,388 m² footprint, but the old hall is single-storey. It runs as a pop-up cinema and event venue. The planned 8,500 m² office block is not confirmed built. 206 registered workers is plausible.

sources.quote: Auf 8500 m² sollen in einem L-förmigen Glasbau Büros entstehen, die mit Schwerpunkt an die Kreativwirtschaft vermietet werden sollen.

findings.evidence_needed: Check whether the office extension (Schönhauser 123) has been built or let, and the current staff of the cinema and event operators.

findings.reason: The mall is not missing. 185 registrations (~519 workers) sit within 40 m. About 24,000 m² of sales area with 90-100 shops, a gym, post office and library implies roughly 500-1,000 workers. 519 is within 2x of that. The OSM floor area (55,784 m²) is inflated: the developer gives 42,000 m² gross.

sources.quote: Die Verkaufsfläche beläuft sich auf 24.000 m².

findings.evidence_needed: Centre management's tenant and staff count; whether the registrations include chain-wide size classes of 500 or more that double count staff.

findings.reason: Name "Büro" (office) is a non-food word, tagged cafe in OSM only. It sits in a row of food shops on Stargarder Straße, so it could be a real café with a quirky name or an office mis-tagged. Cannot tell from data alone.
findings.evidence_needed: Check the venue at Stargarder Straße 72 (street view, Google/OSM reviews) to see if "Büro" is a café or an office.

findings.reason: Godshot Coffee Lab is a specialty coffee business; the OSM "Godshot" office=company 7.7 m away at Gaudystraße 8 is likely its roaster/office with the café. Name fits a café category.
findings.evidence_needed: Confirm Godshot at Gaudystraße 8 has a public café counter and opening hours.

findings.reason: Overture "beverages" record matches the OSM wine shop (same address, 4 m, near-identical name). It is a wine shop, so the category is right; only a duplicate if both sources are counted as separate competitors.
findings.evidence_needed: Verify the pipeline merges this Overture record with OSM node/5337294219 rather than counting both.

findings.reason: K_eins matches an OSM wine shop 7 m away (K eins, Kopenhagener Str. 1). Category "beverages" is consistent with a wine shop. No sign of a category error or duplicate.
findings.evidence_needed: Optionally confirm on the shop's own site or a map that K eins is a wine/beverage retailer.

findings.reason: Kohlenquelle is mapped in OSM as amenity=pub at the same address, 6.5 m away, but the record has it as a cafe. A pub is a bar/evening venue, not a daytime café competitor, so it is probably miscategorised.
findings.evidence_needed: Check the venue's website or Google listing for opening hours and whether it serves coffee/daytime food, or is only a bar.

findings.reason: Balabait Eatery & Deli matches the OSM node "Bala Bait" at Gleimstraße 42 (3.5 m), which is the same business. A deli/eatery fits the food category. Nearby office and bar are different businesses.
findings.evidence_needed: Optionally check the venue's site to confirm it is a deli/eatery rather than a full restaurant.

findings.reason: Overture lists Hala Hala as a supermarket, but an OSM node 11 m away with the same name at Gleimstraße 25 is tagged amenity=restaurant. Likely a restaurant mis-categorised as a supermarket.
findings.evidence_needed: Check the operator's site, Google Maps or street imagery for Hala Hala at Gleimstraße 25: restaurant or grocery?

findings.reason: The name matches an OSM shop=coffee 9 m away (Stargarder Straße 4, spelled "Kafferkontor"). A coffee shop or roaster counts as a café-type competitor. The two records are probably the same shop, but that is a cross-source match, not a duplicate within the competitor set.
findings.evidence_needed: Confirm that the competitor list does not also carry the OSM coffee node as a separate record.

findings.reason: Overture tags Spreegold as a café, but the same-name OSM node 10 m away at Stargarder Straße 82 is amenity=restaurant. It may be a full-service restaurant mis-tagged as a café.
findings.evidence_needed: Check Spreegold's website or menu and opening hours: restaurant or café?

findings.reason: Star Mini Market and Hermes PaketShop are 7 m apart, both späti/kiosk. Parcel shops are commonly run inside a kiosk, so they may be one business listed under two names. The names differ and nothing in the data confirms it.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street imagery or the address: is the Hermes PaketShop inside the Star Mini Market shop?

findings.reason: Netto Marken-Discount (OSM) and Ciao Bella (Overture) are 10 m apart and both tagged supermarket. Ciao Bella sounds like a restaurant or deli, not a supermarket, so it may be a mislabeled or stale record for the same premises. Not confirmed.
findings.evidence_needed: Check whether Ciao Bella is a separate business next to the Netto, or an outdated or wrongly categorised listing at that address.

findings.reason: Two OSM späti nodes 8 m apart, one named L'Epicerie and one unnamed. The unnamed older node (lower ID) is likely the same shop, later re-mapped with a name. Not confirmed.
findings.evidence_needed: Check imagery or an on-site look for one or two shops at this spot; the unnamed node may be a leftover of L'Epicerie.

findings.reason: Two different bakery chains (Junge and Kamps), each confirmed by multiple providers, 4 m apart. Likely adjacent concession units in a station concourse, not one business.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street imagery or a map to see whether both bakeries are separate shopfronts at the station.

findings.reason: "Weingallerie" and "Joachim Rong Weingalerie" are near-identical names (one-letter spelling difference), same category, 3 m apart, from different providers (OSM vs Overture). Almost certainly one wine shop counted twice.
findings.evidence_needed: Confirm on a map or the shop's website that there is a single wine shop at this address.

findings.reason: An unnamed späti/kiosk node 14 m from "Kasatschok Russische Spezialitäten", both OSM only. The unnamed node may be the same shop mapped twice, or a neighbouring kiosk. The data doesn't settle it.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street imagery or OSM tags to see whether the unnamed node is a separate shop or the same Kasatschok shop.

findings.reason: Krümel and Büro are 3.8 m apart, both cafes, with different names. Büro is an OSM-only node. It could be a second name or a separate venue in the same building, or a bar or coworking space mis-tagged as a cafe. The data doesn't say they are one business.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street imagery or the OSM tags (address, opening hours, website) for both nodes. Confirm whether Büro is a separate venue or an alias of Krümel.

findings.reason: Krümel and Café LUC have different names and are 13 m apart. Close cafes with different names are common, and nothing points to one business.
findings.evidence_needed: Check the addresses and whether Café LUC is still open at that spot, using a map or street imagery.

findings.reason: Espresso House and Balzac Coffee are distinct competing coffee chains. They are 10 m apart, which is normal for a station-area concourse. Different brands are not one business. One of the two may be a closed outlet that is still listed.
findings.evidence_needed: Check on a map or the chains' store locators whether both outlets currently trade at Schönhauser Allee station.

findings.reason: Two different names (Kuki's, Daddy's Steak Kebap) about 8 m apart, both OSM-only. Nothing in the data points to one business; neighbouring snack shops are common.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street imagery or a map to see whether the two names share one shopfront.

findings.reason: Kaplan (döner) and Kettwurst! (sausage) are different names and concepts, about 10 m apart at a busy station junction. Nothing indicates one business.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street imagery to see whether these are separate kiosks or stalls.

findings.reason: Brocca Café and YogaCafé - Mindful Life are about 12 m apart. The YogaCafé record comes from Foursquare and may be a former or stale listing at the same address. It may also be a separate yoga studio with a café. The names differ, so this is unconfirmed.
findings.evidence_needed: Check whether YogaCafé still operates and whether it shares the address with Brocca Café (current listings, street imagery).

findings.reason: dean&david and Wrapublic are different brands, about 10 m apart. This is common in station concourses and malls. Nothing in the data points to one business.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street imagery or the venues' sites to see whether both outlets exist separately at the Schönhauser Allee Arcaden.

findings.reason: Two cafés 11 m apart with different names (Büro, Café LUC). That is close enough to be one venue listed under two names, for example a venue name versus its operator or brand name. Without a source this is not confirmed.
findings.evidence_needed: Check whether a café named Büro or Café LUC exists at this address, whether one renamed, or whether they are two separate cafés.

findings.reason: "Francisco Deutschland GmbH" looks like a company or registry name, not a shop brand. It sits 14 m from REWE and both are supermarkets. It may be a franchise operator entry for the same REWE store.
findings.evidence_needed: Check whether Francisco Deutschland GmbH operates this REWE, and whether a second supermarket exists next to it.

findings.reason: Two supermarket records 12 m apart with different names. "Francisco Deutschland GmbH" looks like a company name, not a shop. "Ciao Bella" may be a small Italian food shop. They could be one business, but the data does not show it.
findings.evidence_needed: Check the street address and map listing at this spot: is Ciao Bella a shop run by Francisco Deutschland GmbH, or are they separate businesses?

findings.reason: The names differ (a company name versus an EDEKA branch) and the records are 14.5 m apart. Nothing in the data shows they are one business. Shops often sit this close together.
findings.evidence_needed: Check street-level imagery or the addresses to see whether these are separate shops.

findings.reason: REWE and EDEKA are competing chains but have identical coordinates and the same providers (microsoft, overture). One of the two is probably a wrong or stale label for a single store. Only one supermarket is likely there.
findings.evidence_needed: Check which chain operates at Schönhauser Allee at this point (store locator or street imagery), and drop the other record.

## Über uns

### Fachärztlich. Kompetent. Zuverlässig.

Seit nunmehr [**über 60 Jahren**](https://www.mdi-limbach-berlin.de/unser-labor/ueber-uns/historie/) steht das MDI Limbach Berlin, vormals MDI Laboratorien GmbH - MVZ und MVZ Limbach Berlin, für qualitätsbewusste labormedizinische Diagnostik in Berlin und Brandenburg.  

Rund **300 Mitarbeiter** stehen dem Rhythmus des Laboratoriums zur Verfügung, im ständigen Bemühen um hochspezialisierte, aktuelle und kompetente Betreuung ihrer Patienten und Kunden.  

Unser Labor ist **akkreditiert** D-ML-13341-01-00 nach DIN ISO 15189, das Qualitätszertifikat liegt vor, was sicherstellt, dass die Arbeitsprozesse optimal ablaufen bei hochwertiger Qualität, fachlicher Kompetenz und exzellentem Service mit dem Streben nach weiterer Dynamik und Flexibilität – ein zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen. Ebenso verfügen wir über eine Zulassung für Laboruntersuchungen nach §20b AMG und sind spezialisiert auf hochwertige Untersuchungen für Kinderwunschzentren, Fertility-Zentren und Invitro-Zentren.  

 [](https://www.mdi-limbach-berlin.de/unser-labor/abteilungen/qualitaetsmanagement/ "Qualitätsmanagement")

![](https://www.mdi-limbach-berlin.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Berlin/Images/01_Unser_Labor/Abteilungen/QM/Ilac-Dakks_300.png)

  
Seit ihrer Gründung haben sich die Medizinisch-Diagnostischen Institute Limbach Berlin zu einem der leistungsfähigsten Laboranbieter im Raum Berlin und Brandenburg entwickelt. Proben aus vielen Städten unseres Landes aber auch aus dem Ausland erreichen das Labor täglich.  
Aktuell verfügen wir auf einer Gesamtfläche von mehr als 3.500 m2 über sämtliche Methoden der modernen Labordiagnostik, die sich durch ihren hohen Spezialisierungsgrad auszeichnen.

Alle Fachbereiche werden von Fachärzten oder Fachnaturwissenschaftlern geleitet.  

Mehr als 1.200 niedergelassene Ärzte und über 10 Kliniken in Berlin und Brandenburg sowie Dialysen, Arbeitsmedizinische Dienste und Forschungsinstitute vertrauen unserer Kompetenz.  

In unserem Kerngebiet arbeiten wir mit zahlreichen Laborgemeinschaften zusammen und unterhalten ein Logistiknetz, das die Abholung der Proben auf kürzestem Wege und die Versorgung der Praxen mit Material sicherstellt.  

Als Mitglied der **[Limbach Gruppe](https://www.limbachgruppe.com/)**, dem größten inhabergeführten Verbund ärztlicher Laboratorien in der Bundesrepublik, steht unseren Einsendern eine breit gefächerte Diagnostik und zusätzlich das gesamte Spektrum der Spezialdiagnostik in Verbindung mit einem qualitativ hohen Service zur Verfügung. Durch die Zugehörigkeit greifen wir an über 35 Standorten auf eine Vielzahl angesehener Fachärzte und Fachnaturwissenschaftler der Laboratoriumsmedizin zurück, die für einen hohen Qualitätsstandard bürgen und die tägliche Arbeit am Patienten unterstützen können.
